clue.text: Militant left-wing movement opposed to loud American

parts.note: to be opposed to something is to be anti it
f (forte) is the musical direction for loud

explanation.surface: A description of a radical protest group that objects to a noisy American.
explanation.definitionFit: Antifa is the loose anti-fascist protest network usually described as militant and far left.

clue.text: Mission from Alaska shows up

indicators.note: up in a down clue says the run is read from bottom to top
shows means puts on display, so the letters are on view within the words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A mission from Alaska makes an appearance.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'up' reads the hidden run bottom to top.
explanation.definitionFit: The Alamo was a Spanish mission in San Antonio, Texas, site of the 1836 siege.

clue.text: Rumour of secret rendezvous with a knight? This one

indicators.note: a rumour is something heard, so the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: a tryst is a lovers' secret meeting
an is the form of the indefinite article before a vowel

explanation.surface: Gossip about a clandestine meeting with a knight, as the legend tells.
explanation.walkthrough: 'This one' makes it semi-allusive: Tristan's secret meetings with Isolde are the heart of his story.
explanation.definitionFit: Sir Tristan is a knight of the Round Table in Arthurian legend.

clue.text: Story about case facing Italy's top mathematician

parts.note: a fib is a small lie, a story
on means about, concerning
acc. abbreviates accusative, a grammatical case

indicators.note: top means the first letter

explanation.surface: A lie about a lawsuit brought against Italy's leading number expert.
explanation.definitionFit: Leonardo Fibonacci was the medieval Italian mathematician of the famous number sequence.

clue.text: Dad's a philosopher

parts.note: Pop is an informal word for a father
per means a or each, as in once a day

explanation.surface: A child boasting that their father is a thinker.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of Dad's reads as is, a link; 'a' gives PER, as in so much per day.
explanation.definitionFit: Karl Popper was the Austrian-British philosopher of science known for falsifiability.

clue.text: Tests circuit while controlling inductance

parts.note: an OR gate is a basic logic circuit

indicators.note: controlling means holding in hand, so the letters surround the symbol

parts.note: as means while, during the time that
L is the symbol for inductance in physics

explanation.surface: An electrical engineering exam about circuits and inductance.
explanation.definitionFit: Orals are spoken examinations, tests answered by mouth.

clue.text: Nuts stage uprising in German city

indicators.note: uprising in a down clue means the letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: nuts means mad, crazy
a stop is a stage on a journey

explanation.surface: Revolutionaries stage a crazy revolt in a German town.
explanation.definitionFit: Potsdam is the capital of Brandenburg, near Berlin, scene of the 1945 conference.

clue.text: Group leader set to go first

indicators.note: to go first places the set ahead of the leader

parts.note: a radio is a wireless set
a head is a leader

explanation.surface: A team captain is ready to start.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set' reads as ready, but is a radio set.
explanation.definitionFit: Radiohead is the English rock band, a musical group.

clue.text: Male setter's inside playing Arab instrument

indicators.note: inside says the setter's words go within the other letters
playing suggests the letters of Arab are put through their paces into a new order

parts.note: the setter speaking of himself says 'I am', shortened to I'm

explanation.surface: A man performs on an Arab instrument, with the setter tucked in somewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'setter's' is I'm, the setter speaking as I; 'playing' rearranges Arab, and 'inside' places the setter within it.
explanation.definitionFit: A marimba is a large wooden xylophone-like percussion instrument with resonators.

clue.text: Worker having gone through loadsamoney gets the classifieds

indicators.note: the worker has gone through the money, so it ends up inside it

parts.note: wads of cash are loads of money
the worker ant is the crossword's standard worker

explanation.surface: An employee who has squandered a fortune ends up scanning the small ads for jobs.
explanation.definitionFit: Want ads are small advertisements listing items or jobs sought, the classified section of a paper.

clue.text: Does tramp shower in the powder room?

indicators.note: to shower is to scatter, so the letters are strewn about

explanation.surface: Does a vagrant wash in the ladies' toilet?
explanation.walkthrough: 'powder room' is a ladies' toilet in the surface, but here a store for gunpowder.
explanation.definitionFit: An arms depot stores weapons and ammunition, including gunpowder.

clue.text: Hamlet's oppo battled, some say, wearing women's underwear

indicators.note: some say tells us the word is heard rather than read, pronounced in a non-rhotic accent

parts.note: battled means fought
one dressed in clothes is in them
bras are women's underwear

explanation.surface: A saucy picture of Hamlet's rival fighting in lingerie.
explanation.definitionFit: In Shakespeare's play the Norwegian prince Fortinbras is the foil and rival to the Danish prince.

clue.text: Inevitable annihilation has war department circling round in a spin

indicators.note: in a spin says the whole is turned about and read backwards
circling says the department's letters surround the round letter

parts.note: MOD is the Ministry of Defence, Britain's war department
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: A government defence office in turmoil faces certain destruction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'circling' gives MOOD, which 'in a spin' turns around.
explanation.definitionFit: Doom is an unavoidable terrible fate, ruin that cannot be escaped.

clue.text: Wolves cut across province creating overwhelming terror

indicators.note: the shortened pack is spread across the province, holding it inside
cut says the word loses its final letter

parts.note: wolves hunt as a pack
NI is Northern Ireland, often called the Province

explanation.surface: Wolves roaming over a region spread fear.
explanation.walkthrough: NI is Northern Ireland, known in Britain as the Province; 'cut' docks the pack's last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Panic is sudden uncontrollable fear that overwhelms reason.

clue.text: Screwed a receptor to make babies

indicators.note: screwed means twisted out of shape, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A cheeky note on how children come about.
explanation.definitionFit: To procreate is to produce offspring, to have children.

clue.text: A tart prepared to straddle world leader!

indicators.note: to straddle is to have a leg either side, so these letters sit around the leader

parts.note: something prepared is set, ready
Donald Trump, US president, is a world leader

explanation.surface: A cheeky line about a woman of loose morals ready to climb on top of a president.
explanation.definitionFit: Strumpet is an old-fashioned word for a promiscuous woman or prostitute, as is tart in slang.

clue.text: Treacle — no good for reshaping figure

indicators.note: reshaping says the letters are formed into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Syrup is useless for moulding into shape.
explanation.definitionFit: A rectangle is a four-sided geometric figure with right angles.

clue.text: Golden shower secreted by the French woman

indicators.note: secreted by means hidden away inside the French word

parts.note: le is French for the
or is gold in heraldry
a shower is a short fall of rain

explanation.surface: A risqué suggestion about a Frenchwoman's private habits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Golden shower' looks like one phrase but splits into two pieces; or is gold in heraldry.
explanation.definitionFit: Lorraine is a female given name, so it can stand for a woman.

clue.text: Men turned up frequently to work in part of house

indicators.note: turned up in a down clue means the letters read upwards

parts.note: OR is other ranks, the ordinary soldiers
oft is an old word for often
op is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: Workmen often come round to repair a house.
explanation.definitionFit: The rooftop is the top part of a building, the outer surface of its roof.

clue.text: Composer died behind bars

parts.note: John Cage was the American avant-garde composer

explanation.surface: A musician's death in prison.
explanation.definitionFit: Something kept behind bars is locked up, confined in an enclosure.

clue.text: Ezra's in Georgia with the Queen's men

indicators.note: in says one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: GE is the international code for the country Georgia
ER is the Queen, Elizabeth Regina, with the S of the possessive
Ez is a short form of the name Ezra, as for the poet Ezra Pound

explanation.surface: Ezra Pound is in Georgia with the royal entourage.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of Ezra's reads as is.
explanation.definitionFit: Geezers is British slang for men, blokes or chaps.

clue.text: So Vera's content to work

indicators.note: content is what lies within, so take the inner letters of the name

parts.note: to go is to work or function, as a machine goes

explanation.surface: Vera is happy to get on with her job, so to speak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'content' looks like Vera's happy mood but means her contents, the inner letters ER.
explanation.definitionFit: Ergo is Latin for therefore, used in English to mean so or consequently.

clue.text: Cellar to be tarted up? Heavy fabric is required

indicators.note: tarted up means dressed up and rearranged into a new look

explanation.surface: A cellar is being smartened and needs a weighty cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: Brocatelle is a heavy silk or linen fabric with a raised figured pattern, like brocade, used for upholstery.

clue.text: He sings some of Abba's songs

indicators.note: some of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A singer performs a few hits by the Swedish pop group.
explanation.definitionFit: A basso is a male bass singer, the lowest voice in a choir.

clue.text: Miss cuddling upper-class cad?

indicators.note: cuddling means hugging, so these letters wrap around the other

parts.note: to miss is to lose, as with a chance
U is the mark of upper-class usage

explanation.surface: A young woman embraces a posh scoundrel.
explanation.definitionFit: A louse is a contemptible person, just as a cad is a dishonourable man.

clue.text: Doctor locates possible cause of problem for IBS sufferers

definitions.text: possible cause of problem for IBS sufferers

indicators.note: to doctor is to tamper with, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A GP finds what might be upsetting a patient's bowels.
explanation.definitionFit: Milk sugar intolerance is a common trigger of gut trouble for people with irritable bowels.

clue.text: Fiery gas insufficient to stop inauguration of Imperator Augustus

indicators.note: the inauguration is the beginning, so take the first letter
to stop is to plug a gap, so the gas goes inside

parts.note: Gus is a short form of Augustus

indicators.note: insufficient means falling short, so the word loses its last letter

parts.note: neon is a noble gas

explanation.surface: Gas is not enough to halt a Roman emperor's coronation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'insufficient' drops the last letter of the gas; Gus is the familiar short form of Augustus.
explanation.definitionFit: Igneous rock is formed from volcanic heat, so the word means of or like fire.

clue.text: 20th-century poet abandoned new poems

indicators.note: abandoned means wild and unrestrained, so the letters run riot

explanation.surface: A modern poet has given up on some fresh verse.
explanation.definitionFit: William Empson was an English poet and critic, author of Seven Types of Ambiguity.

clue.text: Tenant is short of pills?

parts.note: less means minus, short of
E is slang for an ecstasy tablet, so two of them

explanation.surface: A renter who has run out of medication.
explanation.definitionFit: A lessee holds property on a lease, renting it from the owner.
